{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-10 day average, reduce by 5-15% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to negative (e.g., 0.33 → -0.20).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility: if true outcome deviates >10% from forecast, re-calibrate next period’s forecast toward historical mean.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.33 or 0.50), allow slight upward bias but cap at 5% above recent 15-day average.",
    "If forecast consistently overestimates true outcome (e.g., >10% error over 3+ consecutive days), reduce forecast by 10-20% for next period.",
    "Lag correction: if true outcome is lower than forecast, reduce forecast by 5-10% for next period to account for lagged market reaction."
  ]
}
